thread:
oliver: quick architecture sync - refining onboarding probe semantics and how we isolate heavy validation from serving pools
priya: yes please. current problem: full bench runs occasionally thrash latency-sensitive clusters
leo: we discussed sampling earlier, i think we need a clear contract: light probes for smoke, heavy probes for gated validation. plus a circuit breaker if queues blow up
tina: propose header-based opt-in so runtime doesn't need model-specific logic. e.g. 'X-Probe-Mode: light|heavy' and 'X-Golden-Tag' to indicate which golden group to check against
marco: +1. also include 'X-Async-Callback' url if caller wants results async. heavy runs must be async to avoid timeouts
priya: what about a unique probe id for tracing? makes debugging easier across services
oliver: add 'X-Probe-ID' (uuid) and push it to traces/metrics. also log 'onboard.probe.mode' in telemetry
leo: how many samples for light probe? earlier idea was 1% but that's vague. suggest configurable samples header 'X-Probe-Samples' default 5
tina: defaults are good. runtime will enforce caps to avoid huge requests. add 'X-Max-Token-Estimate' to guard memory allocation
marco: slowpath routing: heavy -> route to "onboard-slowpath" pool. light -> normal fastpath but rate-limited to avoid noisy neighbors
priya: runtime should attach reason tags to route decisions so we can debug routing anomalies: metric 'route.reason=probe_heavy' etc
infra-bot: note: will provision an autoscaling policy for onboard-slowpath (min=0, max=8) and a per-tenant RBAC role for onboarding jobs
leo: need a graceful fallback: if slowpath is full, we should return 202 Accepted with a retry-after header and enqueue in durable queue. don't block callers indefinitely
oliver: agreed. webhook contract needs shape. propose simple JSON: {"probe_id":"...","model":"...","status":"queued|running|complete|failed","results_url":"...","metrics":{"latency_ms":...}}
priya: include a small 'gold_hits' array of golden ids that failed for quick triage
tina: sdk change: add onboard.run(params, probeMode='light|heavy', asyncCallback=...) and default to light. devx-bot will update the python/js SDK stubs once RFC lands
marco: let's also add a health metric: onboard.slowpath.queue_length and an alert when > 50 for 5m
leo: circuit breaker: if failure rate > 10% for 10m, temporarily reject new heavy probes for that model family for 30m and notify owners
oliver: decision summary: headers: X-Probe-Mode, X-Probe-ID, X-Probe-Samples, X-Golden-Tag, X-Async-Callback, X-Max-Token-Estimate. routing: heavy -> onboard-slowpath (async), light -> fastpath (sync). fallback -> 202 + queue. webhook shape as above. health/alerts + circuit-breaker rules. infra to add autoscale + RBAC. devx to update SDK. i'll open RFC PR with examples and a tiny integration test snippet
priya: can you include a minimal curl + webhook example in the RFC? helps oncall + customers
oliver: yes. inline example:

```bash
curl -X POST https://ingest.internal/v1/onboard \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "X-Probe-Mode: heavy" \
  -H "X-Probe-ID: 1f3a9e7b-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-abcdef123456" \
  -H "X-Probe-Samples: 50" \
  -H "X-Golden-Tag: translation-coverage" \
  -H "X-Async-Callback: https://hooks.prod/cb" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"translate-lite-4b","token_estimate":4096}'
```

oliver: example webhook payload we’ll send when done:

```json
{"probe_id":"1f3a9e7b-xxxx","model":"translate-lite-4b","status":"complete","results_url":"https://benchstore.internal/r/abc123","metrics":{"avg_latency_ms":12.3,"p95_latency_ms":40.2},"gold_hits":["g-set-3","g-set-9"]}
```

marco: perfect. can we also include a small CLI tool for ops to replay probes into slowpath for debugging? infra-bot: will draft an example playbook + replay script template
priya: ok thanks. i'll review the RFC once it's up. short follow-ups: add tests to assert headers are enforced and that heavy runs return 202 when slowpath full
oliver: cool. i'll tag runtime, infra, and devx on the PR. rolling it out will be staged: alpha teams -> beta -> GA :rocket:
